detailed_goals: Set up data entry protocols for electronic health records (EHR) in coordination with the EHR Specialist.
Begin entering patient data from the past 3 months into the EHR system, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Identify and resolve any data inconsistencies or missing information in the initial dataset.
Coordinate with the IT Support Technician to ensure secure access to the EHR system and resolve login or connectivity issues.
Prepare a weekly report summarizing data entry progress and challenges for the team.
Review the initial EHR data collected by the Clinical Data Entry Clerk to assess data quality and structure.
Develop a data schema for influenza-related patient records, including symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment.
Create a preliminary data extraction plan to identify influenza cases from the EHR dataset.
Begin building a data pipeline to extract and clean relevant patient data for trend analysis.
Collaborate with the Influenza Surveillance Coordinator to define key influenza indicators for analysis.
Finalize the EHR system configuration to support data collection for influenza surveillance.
Train the Clinical Data Entry Clerk on EHR data entry standards and required fields.
Ensure the EHR system is integrated with the hospital’s data management platform.
Verify data security and compliance with HIPAA regulations for patient information.
Provide technical support to resolve any EHR system issues during data entry.
Define the key influenza surveillance metrics to be tracked (e.g., case counts, age groups, geographic distribution).
Collaborate with the Data Analyst to identify relevant data fields in the EHR system for influenza analysis.
Develop a data request template for the Clinical Data Entry Clerk to collect influenza-specific patient data.
Initiate coordination with local public health authorities to align surveillance goals with regional reporting standards.
Prepare a weekly monitoring plan to track influenza data collection progress.
Ensure the EHR system and data storage infrastructure are operational and secure.
Set up user access and permissions for all team members based on their roles.
Install and configure necessary software tools for data analysis and reporting.
Conduct a system health check to ensure data integrity and backup capabilities.
Provide technical support to resolve any connectivity or software issues affecting data entry and analysis.
